item.title: Beta Iota hosts first STEM Tournament for local students
item.description: Beta Iota's first STEM Tournament united local middle and high school students for math tests and engineering challenges while supporting scholarships for future teachers.

item.title: Troup County receives a clean audit
item.description: Troup County earns a clean FY25 audit, with revenues outpacing expenses for five years and a strong $210 million net position, auditors tell commissioners.

item.title: UPDATE: Juvenile arrested for murder in Tall Pines shooting
item.description: LaGrange police arrest 16-year-old Tavarion Henry, charged as an adult in the Tall Pines Apartments shooting that killed Marshawn Bailey; investigation remains ongoing.

item.title: Troup High School sees 13 athletes sign to the next level
item.description: Troup High School had 13 student athletes (Football: Greg Houston - Huntingdon College, Kaleb McCamey, Bubba Taylor, Monty Heard and Skylen Straughn - Graceland University, Trent Hodo and Desmon Cunningham - NE Oklahoma A&M, Wade Eagnland - Berry, and Garrison Edwards - Navy) (Baseball: Torreion Delaney - Morris College) (Softball: Gracie Baker - Point, Kaylee Umfress - South Georgia State) (Flag football: Tamia Eady - LaGrange College) sign to play at the next level on Wednesday.

item.title: Shelia Beatrice Noble
item.description: Shelia Beatrice Noble passed away on February 3, 2026, at the age of 86. All arrangements are made by Striffler-Hamby Mortuary, 1010 Mooty Bridge Road, LaGrange, GA 30240 (706) 884-8636.

item.title: Long Cane wrestling finishes season as top-ranked team in the state
item.description: It was not the ending to the season the Long Cane wrestling team was hoping for when the middle school state championships were officially canceled after being postponed due to the weather. item.title: Azalea Storytelling Festival events set for February, March
item.description: Free “Taste of Storytelling” Feb. 8 at LaGrange Memorial Library previews the Azalea Storytelling Festival, returning March 6-8 to LaGrange College’s Callaway Auditorium.

item.title: Troup County Schools welcomes Stephanie Workman as new Chief Finance Officer
item.description: Troup County Schools names Stephanie Workman Chief Finance Officer, bringing 25+ years in K–12 education leadership, districtwide strategy, and finance systems improvement.
